title: Year 2 – Computer Science
institution: Faculty of Computer Science, Al. I. Cuza University of Iasi
program: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
description: A comprehensive undergraduate course covering the fundamentals of computer networks: network architectures (OSI, TCP/IP), the network and transport layers (IPv4/IPv6, TCP, UDP), network programming with BSD sockets in C, application-layer protocols (DNS, HTTP, SMTP, FTP), advanced paradigms (RPC, P2P), routing algorithms, wireless networks, and an introduction to network security.
bibliography: Larry L. Peterson, Bruce S. Davie – Computer Networks: A Systems Approach, 6th Edition, 2020
Lewis Van Winkle – Hands-On Network Programming with C, 1st Edition, 2019
Andrew S. Tanenbaum, David J. Wetherall – Computer Networks, 5th Edition
